name: unslop-ui
description: Strip AI-generated UI copy, decorative chrome and chart clutter: eyebrow labels, 01/02/03 numbering, captions explaining what is visible, decorative badges, icons and status dots, arrows and generic names on links, equal stat cards and filler words. Also fixes gradients, edge accent bars, off-scale spacing, heavy weights and decorative motion when asked (--surface), or shows a plan first (--plan).
